articles.title: PGA Tour Announces New Fitness Requirements for 2025 Season
articles.summary: The PGA Tour is implementing new physical performance standards that will require players to meet certain fitness benchmarks. This move emphasizes the growing importance of athletic conditioning in professional golf and could reshape how players approach their off-season training programs.

articles.title: New Study: Rotational Power Training Increases Driving Distance by 7%
articles.summary: Researchers at the University of Birmingham found that a 12-week rotational power program significantly improved clubhead speed in amateur golfers.

articles.title: TaylorMade Releases New Qi10 Driver with AI-Designed Face
articles.summary: The latest driver from TaylorMade features an artificial intelligence-designed face that promises more forgiveness and distance across the entire hitting area.

articles.title: Scottie Scheffler's Trainer Reveals Off-Season Workout Routine
articles.summary: The world #1's fitness coach shares insights into the strength and mobility program that keeps Scheffler at the top of his game.

articles.title: Golf Ball Rollback: What It Means for Your Game
articles.summary: The USGA and R&A have finalized new golf ball distance regulations. Here's how the changes will affect recreational players and what to expect.

articles.title: TPI Releases Updated Movement Screen for 2025
articles.summary: The Titleist Performance Institute has updated their famous golf fitness assessment with new tests targeting hip mobility and thoracic rotation.
